info.title: Virtual Life Node Runtime
info.description: A persistent companion travels between capability-described device nodes. Local prototype with versioned state, output leases, replayable events and shared personality with budgeted long-term memory and optional text dialogue. WebSocket protocol: docs/protocol.md.

200.description: SSE status, snapshot and provisional cumulative-text delta events, followed by one durable DialogueResult in result, or a structured error event. Both dialogue transports share command IDs and receipt recovery.
